notes.title: Balance patch
notes.content:
This is a patch that makes some changes to the overall game balance, with a significant change to the ticket system, and some quality of life changes to grilling and controls.

I was made aware that many people find the game to be almost impossible after the 10 minute mark, since the game previously progressed linearly, with the pace increasing as the game went on. I've decided to make some changes, that [b]makes you have some control over the pace of the game.[/b]

[list]
[*] Every ticket you successfully send off, will decrease the pace.
[*] When you successfully clear the pass (no tickets), the pace will decrease by double the amount of a regular ticket send off.
[*] Increased the max pace window (previously it was a window of 0-10 seconds, now it's 0-20 seconds).
[/list]

Some more quality of life and fairness changes:

[list]
[*] When ingredients on the grill are cooked 100%, they stay at 100% for 5 seconds, giving you a window of time. Previously there was no window of time. This will make multitasking on the grill easier.
[*] Added a mouse sensitivity slider in the settings.
[*] Added a 'Reset' button in the settings to get back to the default settings. (Make sure to click 'Apply'!)
[/list]

notes.title: New Foundations Patch
notes.content:
Just a few bug fixes for the recent big update. Thanks to some keen eyes I've been made aware of a few bugs. All of those have been fixed now.

[list]
[*] Fixed timer going into the negatives/breaking when replaying in same session.
[*] Fixed issue with custom menus not showing up in the lobby screen during the same session.
[*] Made start menu settings more navigable (Escape key option available now in start menu settings)
[*] Fixed ticket text from clipping out of the page. Tickets now dynamically change to fit their text.
[*] Fixed a few texturing issues with the Underground and High Rise maps.
[*] Fixed the dining tables not being solid (You can now parkour)
[*] + Added a new graphic on the top right corner to show the difficulty stage you are at.
[*] + Added controls tutorial hint
[/list]

notes.title: New Foundations Update
notes.content:
It's been a few months since the last bit of news but I've been working on a complete overhaul of UltraCook this whole time. I was very unhappy with the overall quality of the initial release. So without further ado here is what's new:

[list]
[*][b][h3]New Graphics[/h3][/b]
Textures, models, UI, I've redone it all. It is at a much better state now and I'm personally very happy with it.

[*][b][h3]Redone Multiplayer[/h3][/b]
The multiplayer is now [b]stable[/b] and works seamlessly with Steam. Previously the game ran on dedicated servers, now it runs on Steam, which is much better for you and me. [b]No more server being down for maintenance[/b] and since it's Steam servers, [b]you can play multiplayer from any region[/b]. Overall the multiplayer is greatly optimized, with better netcode.

[*][b][h3]Improved Mechanics & Gameplay[/h3][/b]
I've decided to start from scratch and rethink the gameplay loop, it is still the same arcade style loop, but much more refined for [b]fun[/b] and [b]strategy[/b]. The game now runs on a system where it get's harder as you go, not the old way where you choose a difficulty and it remains the same for the entire game. Much like a [b]Risk of Rain[/b] type system.

[*][b][h3]Subtraction, subtraction, subtraction...[/h3][/b]
The initial philosophy behind the update was subtraction, I wanted to get to the bare bones of the fun, find it and then rebuild around that.

There were many things I decided to take out, as when playtesting I found they were getting in the way of the fun rather than adding to it. [b]No more enemy waiters[/b], I know :( many of you may be said to see it go, but it was a choice I made because I felt it was hindering the direction of the game. I hope you understand!

[*]The finer mechanics, such as picking up and putting down ingredients have been optimized too.

[/list]

I'd like to thank my friends for playtesting during this overhaul, and thank the community for keeping me on my toes! I won't lie before this overhaul I had lost a little steam and a lot of life stuff happened. But I'm very glad I kept at it.

notes.title: Hotfix August 28
notes.content: Fixed money not resetting on new rounds on singleplayer.

notes.title: Burgers Update
notes.content:
[h1]Burgers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946547/d7e18508e6ebcdbdec6bc674a207db4519731570.png[/img]

It seems like it should have been in the game from the start, but better late than never!

Now you can live your dream of flipping burgers. The next small and very soon update will have lettuce, tomato, all of that salad stuff. I just wanted to get the basic burger mechanics out to see how you guys like it.

[h2]Stacking[/h2]

The new burger mechanic comes with a new stacking mechanic, as long as you have a burger bun on the plate, you can stack any ingredient on it, you can essentially make your own burger.

So you can do your favourites like[i] [b]sextuple cheese burger, triple prawn burger and double salmon cheese burger[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946547/11213bb5973c3cf038fe00223f10756699017834.png[/img]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Ingredient all have one codebase now so less memory, and the game is a little smaller in storage.
[*] Death upon explosions now show properly in multiplayer.
[*] Ticket bug where the rush would never end is fixed.
[*] Not a bug but added some small audio to enhance the feedback (picking up stuff now has a sound)
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes + New Lobby System + New Recipe Book
notes.content:
[h1]The Chef's Void[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946547/ddfe8bba846ead8bdceb2c77a629a5f8f6877b17.png[/img]

Behold, a new 'in-person' lobby. Needed something a little less boring than the previous old UI.

Currently it's quite plain, a little creepy. But it's definitley a step in the right direction. Next update the lobby will have much more character and options.

The lobby also shows game results! That's also another thing that's been updated.

[h1]Grades[/h1]

Your 'shifts' will have a 'Grade' (ranging from F, C, B, A, A+). Based on your perfect dishes score, complaints and profit. Previously I felt it was hard to grasp how well exactly you did in a round.

[h1]Updated Recipe Book Look![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946547/f445c8c4dfb62b558a24feb409ddf867f62fe92d.png[/img]

Say goodbye to the out of place 2D Recipe Book. Been meaning to update it.

I hope scrolling with it is not too much of a problem? Do let me know.

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Singleplayer bug fix for waiters throwing plates upwards.
[*] Fire Extinguisher no longer keeps extinguishing after you put it down (previously if you kept holding it down and then dropped it, it would keep firing)
[*] Crashing/issues upon disconnecting mid-game fixed.
[*] When the lobby host quits it kicks everyone, you no longer have to sit awkwardly in an empty lobby.
[*] I also decluttered the hell out of the server-side so you know. I don't want to say it's stable because I don't want to jinx it.
[/list]

Thanks, more to come!

notes.title: Some big bug fixes
notes.content:

[h2][b]Game Client:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Server stability overall much better, less of that annoying 'under maintenance' notice.
[*] Server net-code update giving way to less crashing
[/list]

notes.title: Month long development hiatus...
notes.content:
Hey all,

It's been a little more than a week since the early access release. [b]And I can't think everyone who bought the game more![/b]

All this has only made me more determined to add more polish and features to the game, so again thank you.

But this is announcement is to let everyone know that unfortunately 

[b][h3]I'll be having to take a month off working on this due to travel & family matters[/h3][/b]

I hope everyone looking forward to more progress with the game can be patient with me whilst sorting a few things out, outside of development.

In the meantime I will be planning during this short hiatus while I can. So rest assured updates will come swiftly after said hiatus.

Thank you all again,
- RAINPROXY
